cmd: find /app/service/src -type f | head -50 && echo --- && for f in $(find /app/service/src -type f); do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
which java javac mvn; ls /opt /usr/local 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 4 -name "mvn" -type f 2>/dev/null | head
find / -maxdepth 6 -name "mvn*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head; ls -la ~; ls /root 2>/dev/null
which apt-get yum dnf apk 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; timeout 10 curl -sI https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ | head -3
timeout 300 apt-get install -y maven 2>&1 | tail -3 || (timeout 300 apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 300 apt-get install -y maven 2>&1 | tail -3)
timeout 300 apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 600 apt-get install -y maven 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn -q dependency:tree -Dincludes='*:slf4j-api,*:logback*,*log4j*' 2>&1 | grep -E "slf4j|logback|log4j|INFO|ERROR|---" | head -60
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | tee /tmp/tree.txt | grep -E "slf4j|logback|log4j" | head -40
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | sed -e 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "slf4j|logback|log4j"
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn clean compile 2>&1 | sed -e 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "BUILD|ERROR" | head
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn test 2>&1 | sed -e 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "Tests run|BUILD|ERROR|NoSuchMethod" | head -20

cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn -q dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=/tmp/cp.txt 2>&1 | tail -1; (timeout 30 java -cp target/classes:$(cat /tmp/cp.txt) com.example.service.LoggingService
